current_grouping: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop

versions.grouping_at_time: Section 20 — Aerial Delivery: Air Transport and Airdrop
versions.text:
Standard: Cargo is loaded and handled in a manner to prevent it from either becoming an ignition source itself or from contacting any ignition sources. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review air vehicle engineering drawings to verify sources, locations, and configurations of possible ignition sources.
(2) Integrate cargo engineering drawings with air vehicle engineering drawings to verify existence of cargo clearances and means of preventing cargo contact with ignition sources. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct ground demonstration to verify cargo clearances and preventive means of contacting ignition sources exist. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Perform testing, including but not limited to explosive atmosphere testing, to show cargo items do not become ignition sources IAW MIL-STD-810, Explosive Atmosphere paragraph.
